name: M3-like (Material 3-inspired)
description: An independent approximation of Material Design 3's baseline look, expressed purely as values over Tanrei's vocabulary: a chromatic primary, tonal surfaces, pill buttons, shadow elevation without a ring.

attribution.disclaimer: Tanrei is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Google. "Material Design" is Google's; this preset is an independent approximation derived from publicly available, Apache-2.0 licensed design tokens.

tertiary.description: Material Design 3 has a third accent family for contrast and balance. It is particular to that system, so this preset declares it instead of Tanrei carrying the slot for everyone. Tones the reference publishes are fixed to its exact colors; any other tone is generated.

tanrei.sys.behavior.divider-visibility.reason: Material's top app bar lies flat until content scrolls under it, and its dialogs show the dividers above and below their scrolling content only while content lies beyond them (Material Web's dialog).

tanrei.sys.behavior.separation.reason: Material's joined buttons stand a narrow gap apart, and its determinate progress indicators leave a gap before the track and draw a stop. Its menus part groups with a line: the menu's own choice is set back to divider when the menu reads it.
